# Notably - LLM full snapshot
Last updated: 2026-09-03
Primary website: https://notably.no/

This document is for machine reading and retrieval. It summarizes key product information for Notably and points to canonical URLs.

## One-line summary
Notably is a Norwegian AI meeting assistant that automates meeting notes, summaries, action items and post-meeting follow-up.

## Core positioning
- AI meeting notes for Norwegian teams.
- Designed for AI motereferat / AI motenotater workflows.
- Focus on productivity and meeting knowledge retention.

## Product capabilities
- Automatic meeting documentation.
- Meeting summaries with key decisions and tasks.
- Cross-meeting question answering in the product UI.
- Integrations shown on site: Microsoft Teams, Outlook Calendar, Google Meet, Google Calendar.
- Stated platform support on homepage: Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet.

## Security and privacy claims on site
- GDPR-compatible workflows.
- Core customer content systems self-hosted in Germany (Hetzner, Nuremberg and Falkenstein).
- Encryption: TLS in transit, plus access controls and workspace separation.
- No training on customer data.
- Optional analytics and marketing tags (Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel) load only after consent in Personvernvalg.
- All customer content (meetings, recordings, transcripts, summaries and email sent from Notably) is stored and processed in the EU/EEA. The exceptions do not concern meeting content: payments (Stripe), mobile push notifications (which contain no meeting titles), sign-in with Google, Microsoft or Apple if the user chooses it, and AI tools the customer connects themselves. Provider support, security and moderation staff at ElevenLabs and Microsoft may in limited cases access data from outside the EU; this is governed by data processing agreements and the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

## Pricing snapshot
- Notably: 399 NOK per user per month.
- Enterprise: contact sales.
- Trial: 14 days on the standard plan.
